name: fantasy-hub
status_detail: Multi-league fantasy football tools. Renamed from Dynasty Hub 2026-08-14. Every tool now lives under /l/[leagueId] with leagues auto-discovered from Sleeper and format detected from settings.type. Two live leagues: Dah Dynasty League (dynasty, in season) and 2026 Half PPR (redraft, pre-draft). Values switch source by format: RosterAudit for dynasty, FantasyCalc redraft otherwise. Jingles Labs research curated in as an annotation layer.
next_steps: Add the Lab 300 (Jingles Labs top-300 half-PPR) when it publishes, due 2026-08-16
Phase 2: split season-plan into per-format strategy rule sets (redraft playoff odds, buy/sell windows, bye coverage)
Redraft-specific draft board: ADP tiers and roster construction, before the 2026 Half PPR draft (not yet scheduled)
Phase 3: guillotine support once a league exists; no Sleeper representation so it needs a manual source
Wire 2026 NFL schedule into survivor future-scarcity grid
Integrate Vegas lines via the-odds-api before Week 1
blockers: Guillotine league not joined yet and host platform unknown, so Phase 3 cannot be designed against real rules
FantasyCalc redraft returns only 200 players (dynasty returns 475) and the limit param is ignored, thin for a 14-round 12-team draft
notes: 2026-08-14: Phase 1 multi-league shipped. Routes moved from /dynasty to /l/[leagueId] with permanent redirects, league switcher in the header, nav renders only format-appropriate tools. Values now format-aware: 87 of 200 shared players move 20+ ranks between dynasty and redraft. Jingles Labs added (21 calls, 30 tiered backup RBs). Design spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-multi-league-design.md.
2026-08-14: Renamed Dynasty Hub to Fantasy Hub across code, GitHub repo, Vercel project, and local folder. Live at fantasy-hub-tan.vercel.app; dynasty-hub-nine.vercel.app still resolves.
2026-05-17: Dashboard registration. Last work was survivor Phase 1 (pool config, team matrix, baseline ratings, strategy library) committed 2026-05-10.
